risks.risk: The starter motor may be seized or have a faulty solenoid.
risks.proof: A video of the starter motor being manually turned by hand until it engages.

risks.risk: The radiator may have internal rust or leaks.

risks.risk: The steering rack may have worn or seized pivots.
risks.proof: A video showing the rack being manually turned to demonstrate smooth movement.
